resources.string: See how the checkup is scored
Common rules of thumb, not financial advice. Tap a line to see how it's worked out.

Each line holds one of your numbers against a common rule of thumb, using the figures in your budget sheet. A line passes when your number is on the healthy side of its line; the score is how many pass. The lines aren't weighted, so the order to work on them is below.
Every line passes. Open any of them to see how much room you have and what would change it.
